digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing (heartbeat alert, binding-drift alert, conflict filer)
propositions: Three existing automated bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-filer) lack dedup keys, template contracts, and empty-detail abort guards, causing duplicate tickets and silent breakage on gate changes

Heartbeat-filer must implement a 2-consecutive-red threshold using workflow run-history queries (no new state store) to avoid filing on single flakes, with accumulation capped at one comment per 24h via marker-line dedup on ticket history
Binding-drift-filer requires dedup + template + accumulation + abort-if-empty (no threshold, because drift is persistent state that cannot self-heal between runs)

Conflict-filer in applier.py needs per-conflict stable dedup tag (local id + jira key), template body with failing-output, abort-if-empty exit, and detected_by stamping; no auto-close (human adjudication required)

All automated filers must be documented in a bug-creation contract specifying rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, and REBAR_DETECTED_BY, with an audit table mapping each site to applicable pattern elements and their rationale
